_comment: T-135 model registry: the ONLY place model names live. Override any task at runtime with AI_MODEL_<TASK> (e.g. AI_MODEL_ADJUDICATION=anthropic:claude-opus-5-5). Prices are USD per 1M tokens, copied from the providers' published pages on the asOf date; update them here, never in code. `models` holds per-model request capabilities; a model not listed keeps the legacy request shape (response schema, system prompt as a primed turn, temperature).
